summary: Proposition 42 bans two kinds of new state taxes. The state could not create new taxes on simply owning or holding personal property or assets — such as savings, investments, or other belongings — and could not impose most taxes retroactively, reaching back to earlier tax years. The bans have limited exceptions and apply to taxes passed or taking effect on or after January 1, 2026.
what_yes_means: A yes vote blocks new state taxes on owning or holding personal property or assets, and most retroactive state taxes.
what_no_means: A no vote keeps current law, which does not contain these bans; no existing tax changes either way.
